title: Local models
intro: Run agents on a model on this computer (Ollama, LM Studio) or on your local network. Nothing leaves your network, and agents can never add an address here.

add.urlHint: An IP address or localhost, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434 (Ollama) or http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 (LM Studio).

offlineHint: Put a local model in an agent's fallbacks (Brains and fallbacks) and mark a routine "Run even offline": when the main brain can't be reached, that routine runs on the local model and says so.
